notes: Same machine and BIOS (Dell 1.37.0) as optiplex-7080-1.37.0. DSDT byte-identical to that set's dsdt.dat (sha256 75b5e2ac...), as are all other shared static tables except BGRT (BGRT carries per-boot logo status).
Linux does not export the XSDT or RSDP; the completeness accounting uses the Windows set's XSDT (same firmware, 24 entries).

Static SSDT1-6 are XSDT-listed. dynamic/SSDT7-13 (CPU power-management: Cpu0Cst/Cpu0Ist/Cpu0Psd/ApIst/ApHwp/ApPsd/ApCst) were installed at runtime by the firmware's own Load/LoadTable, never XSDT-listed; ingested as dynamic-SSDT7..13 with runtime_loaded=true. The graders load them after the static tables, i.e. Linux's post-boot namespace.

2 XSDT entries are in neither the Linux nor the Windows dump; their signatures cannot be named from the XSDT (addresses only). The delivery note says 'no MSDM/SLIC' without stating whether they were absent or removed; if they were removed, these 2 are excluded_by_rule, not missing.
